classes.name: ChiseiPublicApiV1
classes.description: The clean-break Sekai Chisei 1.0 public gRPC surface: 31 Chisei operations. The surface keeps four external-action lifecycle operations, three Gunshi allocation operations, three gateway-coordination operations, and the strict lookup-first promotion gate. Native text execution is a PlanExecution -> ExecutePlanStream pipeline with Kioku enrichment and optional Gunshi allocation provenance; bounded ordered content uses the separate PlanContentExecution -> ExecuteContentPlanStream pipeline so older servers fail explicitly. Gateway admission is canonicalized in DecideGatewayExecution; standalone budget checks and policy resolution are internal. Evaluation read/analytics facades, plan-backed governed-subject evaluation, operation statistics, and public policy dry-run are removed; receipts remain the authoritative query path.

classes.name: LookupFirstPromotionGate
classes.description: A strict Chisei v1 evaluation boundary that executes a bounded structured lookup-vs-golden fixture suite for one namespace, compares exact lookup-hit answers or explicit model-path refusals, records only bounded secret-free audit evidence, and leaves the prior route policy unchanged on failure.

properties.name: suite_digest
properties.description: The canonical SHA-256 digest of the operator-owned structured suite.

properties.name: verdict
properties.description: The closed gate outcome: allow when every case passes, otherwise deny.

properties.name: audit_decision_id
properties.description: The durable audit decision identifier for the gate result.

classes.name: LookupFirstPromotionGateSuite
classes.description: An operator-owned strict v1 JSON artifact containing a finite namespace-scoped set of structured lookup capabilities with exact golden answers or explicit bounded model-path refusals; free-form natural language, shadow-model fields, provider calls, and automatic route-policy application are outside the contract.

relations.name: exposes_lookup_first_promotion_gate
relations.description: The Chisei public API exposes the authenticated RunLookupFirstPromotionGate operation as the strict v1 lookup-first promotion boundary.

relations.name: evaluates_lookup_promotion_suite
relations.description: A lookup-first promotion gate evaluates exactly one operator-owned structured fixture suite per invocation.
